signals.title: AaronShemtov/ai-agents-platform
signals.content: Personal AI agent platform: Telegram-driven agents with MCP tools for GitHub, Cloudflare and Kubernetes
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance; implementation ecosystem relevance. Final score: 79. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: AaronShemtov/ai-agents-platform

Brief: A personal AI agent platform that operates via Telegram. The system integrates multi‑channel processing (MCP) tools to interact with GitHub repositories, Cloudflare services, and Kubernetes clusters. It enables users to issue commands and receive automated responses for code management, DNS/edge configuration, and container orchestration. The platform is open‑source and relies on existing APIs; its effectiveness depends on proper configuration and access permissions. Current public information does not confirm large‑scale deployment or commercial adoption.
signals.brief_ar:
العنوان: AaronShemtov/ai-agents-platform

الملخص: منصة وكيل ذكاء اصطناعي شخصية تعمل عبر تيليجرام. تدمج أدوات المعالجة متعددة القنوات (MCP) للتفاعل مع مستودعات GitHub، وخدمات Cloudflare، ومجموعات Kubernetes. تمكّن المستخدمين من إرسال أوامر وتلقي ردود آلية لإدارة الشيفرة، وضبط إعدادات DNS/الحافة، وتنسيق الحاويات. المنصة مفتوحة المصدر وتعتمد على واجهات برمجة التطبيقات المتاحة؛ فعاليتها تعتمد على الإعداد الصحيح وصلاحيات الوصول. لا تُظهر المعلومات العامة الحالية انتشاراً واسعاً أو تبنياً تجارياً للمنصة.

signals.title: samjd-zz/linkedin_ssi_booster
signals.content: An adaptive continually learning hybrid RAG Agent for content, curation, and persona growth. It combines spaCy-based NLP, a persona graph, BM25 retrieval, a truth gate, confidence scoring, and local memory to generate, curate, rank, and route posts with more control than a basic AI writer workflow.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance; retrieval/RAG relevance. Final score: 75. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: samjd-zz/linkedin_ssi_booster

Brief: This hybrid Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) agent continuously learns and adapts to improve content creation, curation, and persona development for LinkedIn. It integrates spaCy NLP, a persona graph, BM25 retrieval, a truth‑gate filter, confidence scoring, and local memory. The system generates, curates, ranks, and routes posts, offering greater editorial control than a standard AI writer workflow. OSINT‑derived data informs the truth gate, but the model’s outputs retain uncertainty where source verification is limited.

الملخص: هذا الوكيل الهجين القائم على استرجاع‑المولد (RAG) يتعلم باستمرار لتطوير إنشاء المحتوى، وتنسيقه، وتطور الشخصية على لينكدإن. يجمع بين معالجة اللغة الطبيعية باستخدام spaCy، رسم بياني للشخصية، استرجاع BM25، بوابة تحقق من الحقيقة، تقييم الثقة، وذاكرة محلية. ينتج الوكيل منشورات، ينسقها، يرتبها ويوجهها، مما يمنح تحكمًا تحريرياً أعلى من سير عمل كاتب الذكاء الاصطناعي التقليدي. تعتمد بوابة الحقيقة على بيانات OSINT، لكن النتائج تظل تحمل درجة من عدم اليقين عندما تكون مصادر التحقق غير كافية.

signals.content: Command-line tooling and an AI agent for the PROCESIO automation platform: drive processes, forms, documents and custom actions from a terminal or from an AI coding assistant.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 66. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en: Procesio-Externals/procesio-cli is a command‑line interface and AI‑driven agent for the PROCESIO automation platform. It enables users to invoke processes, manage forms and documents, and trigger custom actions directly from a terminal or via an AI coding assistant. The tool is open‑source, leverages the platform's REST API, and is intended for developers and operations teams seeking scriptable, low‑code integration. Current documentation notes basic functionality; advanced workflow orchestration and security hardening are under active development.

signals.title: onur-kesim/hafiza-kur
signals.content: A portable project-memory gate system for AI agents. Single-file, pure Python stdlib, zero dependencies. A gate that does not bite has no verdict.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 58. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: onur-kesim/hafiza-kur
A portable, single‑file Python gate for AI agents. Implemented with only the standard library, it requires no external dependencies. The gate acts as a memory‑access checkpoint: it can be invoked to store or retrieve context without imposing any automatic decision. Its behavior is neutral—no verdict is issued unless the calling agent explicitly defines one. This design supports flexible, OSINT‑style integration while preserving uncertainty about outcomes.
